# User Checks

This page describes the `usercheck` slice of the core plugin `claudetto`.
It is for a user who wants a check that only the user can run to come with the exact command, and for a contributor who edits the slice.

## The Problem

A permission check can deny a call, for example in auto mode.
The work can then have a check that only the user can run.
A reply that says "run the check" and gives no command makes the user find the command.
The `verification` section of the prompt tells Claude to give the exact `!` command.
A prompt is the weakest control, so the slice adds a hook.

## What the Hooks Do

1. The `classic.PermissionDenied` hook keeps each denied call of the session.
   For a `Bash` call, it keeps the first line of the command.
   For another tool, it keeps the name of the tool.
2. The `classic.Stop` hook reads the reply (`last_assistant_message`).
   When the session has denied calls and the reply has no `!` command, the hook blocks the stop one time.
   The reason names the denied calls and asks Claude for the exact `!` command, or for one sentence that says that the work does not need the call.
3. Each `Stop` clears the denied calls.
   A stop that is a continuation of a block (`stop_hook_active`) is not blocked.
   For this reason, a denial gives at most one block.

## How It Finds a `!` Command

The hook reads the Markdown syntax of the reply, and not its words, so it works in each language of the reply.
A `!` command is a code item that starts with `!`, such as `` `! just sandbox > /tmp/out.txt 2>&1` ``,
or a line in a code block that starts with `!`.
A `!` outside code is not a command.

## Cost

The hooks make no model call.
A block costs one more model response, and only in a turn with a denied call and no `!` command.

## Bounds

| Bound | Value | File | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MAX_NAMED_CALLS` | 5 | `slices/usercheck/limits.ts` | Most denied calls that one reason names |
| `MAX_CALL_CHARS` | 200 | `slices/usercheck/limits.ts` | Most characters of one denied call in the reason |
